2607.06519.title: FreqDepthKV: Frequency-Guided Depth Sharing for Robust KV Cache Compression in Long-Context LLM Inference
2607.06519.paper_summary: Long-context LLM inference is increasingly limited by the memory and bandwidth cost of KV caches, yet aggressive compression can remove the layer-specific evidence needed for retrieval and multi-step reasoning. We introduce FreqDepthKV, an inference-time cache compression method that factorizes adjacent-layer KV states into shared low-frequency depth components and sparse high-frequency residuals. A lightweight online probe assigns attention heads to shared-depth, residual-depth, or exact cache modes according to their contribution to reconstruction-sensitive attention logits, allowing the compression policy to adapt to prompt structure without retraining. Across long-context question answering, needle retrieval, summarization, and code generation benchmarks, FreqDepthKV preserves task accuracy under substantially smaller cache budgets. With a 32k-token prefill window, FreqDepthKV reaches 58.3 Exact Match, 63.0 F1, 32.5 ROUGE-L, and 48.1 pass@1, closely matching full KV while outperforming prior compressed-cache methods. It also improves decoding throughput to 70.4 tokens/s, reduces TTFT to 2.06 seconds, and lowers peak KV memory to 6.2 GB, achieving a 3.9x effective compression ratio.
2607.06519.paper_summary_zh: 長期上下文 LLM 推理越來越受到 KV 快取的記憶體和頻寬成本的限制，但激進的壓縮可能會移除檢索和多步推理所需的層特定證據。我們介紹了 FreqDepthKV，一種推理時快取壓縮方法，將相鄰層的 KV 狀態分解為共享的低頻深度組件和稀疏的高頻殘差。一個輕量級的在線探測器根據它們對重建敏感的注意力邏輯的貢獻，將注意力頭分配給共享深度、殘差深度或精確快取模式，允許壓縮策略根據提示結構進行調整，而無需重新訓練。在長上下文問答、針對針的檢索、摘要和代碼生成基準中，FreqDepthKV 在顯著較小的快取預算下保持任務準確性。在 32k 令牌的預填充窗口中，FreqDepthKV 達到了 58.3 的精確匹配，63.0 的 F1，32.5 的 ROUGE-L 和 48.1 的 pass@1，與完整的 KV 緊密匹配，同時超越了先前的壓縮快取方法。它還將解碼吞吐量提高到 70.4 令牌/秒，將 TTFT 降低到 2.06 秒，並將峰值 KV 記憶體降低到 6.2 GB，實現了 3.9 倍的有效壓縮比。
